text: Flux reconstruction: flux correction, DG and 1D periodic advection Flux reconstruction (FR) builds high-order conservation-law discretizations by correcting a polynomial flux inside each element with shared interface fluxes. Elements exchange information through numerical fluxes rather than enforcing a continuous solution. The correction function is part of the method definition; the name FR alone specifies neither accuracy nor stability.
